hero_background.description: Abstract cubic molecule network for the hero section background to emphasize chemistry and AI.

feature_ai_vision.description: Futuristic lab/scanner room for the Chemical Scanner page or empty states.

hazard_texture.description: Yellow skull hazard sign for the Safety Library or severe risk level accents.

typography.strategy: The 'Tech / AI' strategy. Use Outfit for high-impact, futuristic, yet professional headings. Use Manrope for high-legibility data reading in the dashboard. Large headings should have tight tracking.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & TECH (Premium, Depth, Safety) mixed with neon alerts

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for all major cards and sticky headers. Use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px inner subtle border. NO completely transparent dropdowns or overlays over content. Add a subtle trace-beam effect on premium AI elements.
visual_enhancers.effects: Soft glowing gradients behind primary cards. E.g., a cyan or green glow blur (blur-3xl) anchored behind the AI Scanner box.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient colored shadows for active states (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,242,254,0.3)] for a scanning state).

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12). Bento grid system for the dashboard (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
layouts.marketing_page: High impact asymmetry, massive typography, overlapping hero image overlay (bg-black/40), wide gap bento grids.
layouts.dashboard: Dense, precise widget grids (gap-4 or gap-6). Left-aligned content for scanning and safety data. Clear, cardless look inside the glass panels.

motion.interactions: Hover states must increase contrast and include micro-lifts (-translate-y-1) for glass cards.
motion.animations: AI scanning animation (moving linear gradient or scanner beam over the image). Animated gauge filling from 0 to actual risk level. Subtle molecule particles floating in the hero background.

components.buttons: Rounded-xl or pill-shaped with sharp hover transitions and glowing shadows on primary actions.
components.shadcn_customization: Heavily modify Shadcn cards to incorporate glassmorphism (bg-transparent, backdrop-blur-md, solid border-white/10). Modify tabs and dropdowns to have solid/frosted backgrounds to prevent text collision. Use Shadcn Recharts for the risk distribution donut chart.
components.icons: Use lucide-react for safety and tech icons. Maintain consistent stroke width across all icons.

accessibility.contrast: Text over gradients or images MUST have adequate drop-shadow or heavy overlay. Primary buttons must meet 4.5:1 contrast against their backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, scanner dropzone, auth forms) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-chemical-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive React application using Shadcn UI mapping all requested pages (Landing, Auth, Dashboard, Scanner, Result, Map, History, Library, Settings).
Implement the 'data-testid' on all interactive elements as it is critical for testing.
Ensure both Light and Dark modes are fully supported. The transition should be seamless via a Settings toggle.
Integrate the 'Gemini 3 Flash' real AI vision logic (or mock it clearly with instructions if API key is not present), emphasizing the UI scanning animation.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on any floating elements like dropdowns, modals, or dialogs—they must use a solid or heavily blurred background.
Utilize 'lucide-react' for all iconography. Never use emojis as UI icons.
Use Recharts for the Risk Gauge (half donut) and Risk Distribution Donut chart.
Design the AI Insight card with a premium 'AI' aesthetic (gradient border or glowing edge).
Add animated background particles for molecules (e.g. using tsparticles or custom CSS animations) in the landing hero.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layered Z-indexes and glassmorphism. Use the provided image URLs exclusively; never use placeholder images. Never use AI emojis (🤖🧠) as icons. Do not center align standard text flows, only hero headings. Use custom scrollbars. For interactive transitions, animate specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors), never 'transition-all'. Make the UI feel premium, high-tech, and life-saving.
